answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose RLN rate-limit witness binds each message to one Semaphore identity. A nebula, ivory, or cedar-tagged duplicate message produces two valid shares for the same epoch; Shamir interpolation then exposes the agent’s private key. After verifying the polynomial identity proof, the protocol instantly slashes the collateral, making sybil identities economically unsafe.
